purpose: Separate offline Academy worked practice; no historical case or live traffic collection claimed.
creation: Standard-library deterministic Ethernet/IPv4/TCP packet writer; no network sockets or external traffic.
format: Classic PCAP Ethernet, microseconds. Explicit .pcap filenames replace proposed .pcapng drafts.
timeBasis: All records use the same specified synthetic UTC clock. No measured physical clock corrections exist or are needed.

collectionGap.meaning: Synthetic observation coverage deliberately unavailable in this interval. Absence of packets is not evidence of inactivity. No reconstructed packets are supplied.

limits: HTTP text is intentionally visible and harmless; no encrypted-content or session-secret exercise is claimed.
SSH banners and replies do not establish authentication, command execution or movement.
Synthetic host records do not supply a process-network association or file execution.
A POST body and response establish visible sample transfer, not sensitive-data loss or attacker control.
